translationRepairs: The Burmese chief Mang Dala had been usurped by the Musuo chief; he defeated the Guizhou Mohang, and the Guizhou chief Gong Guyan fled to Menglian.
The Burmese chief Mang Dala had been usurped by the Musuo chief; he defeated the Gui Family of Mohang, and the Gui chief Gong Guyan fled to Menglian.
s0063 has 貴家木邦 and 貴酋, not 貴州; Gui Family / Gui chief correctly replaces the false Guizhou reading.
The Burmese chief Mang Dala had been usurped by the Musuo chief; he defeated the Guizhou Mohang; the Guizhou chief Gong Guyan fled to Menglian.
The Burmese chief Mang Dala had been usurped by the Musuo chief; he defeated the Gui Family Mohang; the Gui chief Gong Guyan fled to Menglian.
Same unit: 貴家 and 貴酋 are Gui Family and Gui chief, not Guizhou; the literal replacement removes that error.

In the second month of the thirtieth year the Muslims of Ush rebelled; the Vice Commander-in-Chief stationed there, Such eng, killed himself; the rebels made the petty beg Lai Heimutula their leader and held out behind the walls.

In the second month of the thirtieth year the Muslims of Ush rebelled; the Vice Commander-in-Chief stationed there, Sucheng, killed himself; the rebels made the petty beg Lai Heimutula their leader and held out behind the walls.
s0119 names 素誠 as one word; the space in "Such eng" is a typographical split of the proper name Sucheng.

In the second month of the thirtieth year the Muslims of Ush rebelled; the Vice Commander-in-Chief stationed at Ush, Such eng, killed himself; the rebels made the petty beg Lai Heimutula their leader and held out in defense.

In the second month of the thirtieth year the Muslims of Ush rebelled; the Vice Commander-in-Chief stationed at Ush, Sucheng, killed himself; the rebels made the petty beg Lai Heimutula their leader and held out in defense.
Literal field has the same erroneous space; 素誠 is Sucheng.

In the eleventh month he reached Wanding and advanced against Mohang; the rebels fled. He left Coordinator Zhulun'e and Surveillance Commissioner Yang Zhongying to hold the place, then led more than ten thousand men across the Xibo River to attack Manjie.

In the eleventh month he reached Wanding and advanced against Mohang; the rebels fled. He left Coordinator Zhulun'e and Surveillance Commissioner Yang Chongying to hold the place, then led more than ten thousand men across the Xibo River to attack Manjie.
s0134 楊重英 is Chongying (重英), matching the chapter figure; Zhongying is a wrong tone/romanization.

Before the edict arrived, in the first month of the thirty-third year the rebels attacked Mohang; Vice Commander-in-Chief Zhulun'e's army collapsed and he killed himself, and Yang Zhongying was seized and taken away.

Before the edict arrived, in the first month of the thirty-third year the rebels attacked Mohang; Vice Commander-in-Chief Zhulun'e's army collapsed and he killed himself, and Yang Chongying was seized and taken away.
s0160 執重英以去 is the same 重英/楊重英 as Chongying; Zhongying must be corrected for consistency.
